# 🕊️ Mercy – Round 1 Loadout Note | [`Threads of Fate`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/threads-of-fate)  
**Build Theme:** *Guardian Angel of Fate*  
**Power:** [`Threads of Fate`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/threads-of-fate)  
**Items:** [`Weapon Grease`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/weapon-grease), [`Compensator`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/compensator), [`Armored Vest`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/armored-vest)  
**Optional Perk:** [`Ballistic Buffer`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/ballistic-buffer) *(conditional)*

---

## 🎯 Power: [`Threads of Fate`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/threads-of-fate)

 *“The thread of life is fragile… unless you’re the one stitching it.”*

This power lets Mercy **turn the tide** with perfect timing. Whether it’s a clutch Res, a lifesaving Valkyrie, or the perfect reposition to deny a pick, `Threads of Fate` gives her the **window to act decisively**.

Especially in Round 1, when fights are chaotic and mistakes are common, this power helps you **take over moments that would normally be out of reach**.

---

## 🛠️ Item Breakdown

### 1. 🔧 [`Weapon Grease`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/weapon-grease)
 *"+5% Attack Speed" — Faster beam ticks = faster healing*

Mercy’s healing and damage beam are considered “attacks,” and this item boosts their **tick rate** by 5%. That means:

- **+5% Healing per Second (HPS)** on your staff
- Makes Valkyrie even stronger due to more frequent ticks

This isn’t about dueling — it’s about **consistency and uptime**. Every second matters, and `Weapon Grease` makes sure you're squeezing more out of each one.

---

### 2. 🔫 [`Compensator`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/compensator)
 *"+5% Weapon Power" — Stronger beams all around*

`Compensator` increases all of Mercy’s beam effects:

- **+5% HPS** from her healing beam
- **+5% blaster damage** for when you need to defend yourself

Think of it as a **direct buff to all your support output**. Stacking this with `Weapon Grease` means you're healing faster *and* healing more per tick — it’s a **double dip of value** that turns Mercy into a **force multiplier**.

---

### 3. 🛡️ [`Armored Vest`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/armored-vest)
 *“+10 Armor — Survive the dive, make the play.”*

Mercy’s one weakness? She dies fast. `Armored Vest` gives her the **early-game tankiness** to:

- **Survive opening dive pressure**
- Safely reposition during chaotic fights
- Make **riskier Resurrects or Valk activations**

It’s especially strong with `Threads of Fate`, since that power **rewards you for living just a second longer**. Vest buys you that second.

---

## ⚠️ Optional Perk: [`Ballistic Buffer`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/ballistic-buffer) *(Situational)*

 **Pick this if enemy has 2+ of these:**  
 Reinhardt 🛡️ | Orisa 🐎 | Ashe 🔫 | Freja ⚔️ | Soldier: 76 👟 | Ana 💉 | Kiriko 🦊

These heroes deal **consistent ranged or projectile damage**, which is exactly what `Ballistic Buffer` counters:

- Reduces damage from **hitscan and projectile weapons**
- Keeps you alive longer in **poke-heavy team comps**

If you're noticing **chip damage or getting deleted during peeks**, sub this in to **stay alive and stay in the fight**.

---

## 🧠 Strategy Tips

- Use [`Threads of Fate`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/threads-of-fate) to  **save key teammates** mid-fight.
- [`Weapon Grease`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/weapon-grease) + [`Compensator`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/compensator) turns Mercy into a **healing machine** right from Round 1.
- [`Armored Vest`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/armored-vest) is your **lifeline** — it gives you time to make those crucial plays.
- If you're taking too much ranged damage, consider [`Ballistic Buffer`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/ballistic-buffer) to help **weather the storm**.

---

 *"Heroes never die — but with this loadout, they barely even get close."*

# 🕊️ Mercy – **Round 2** Loadout Note  
**Items:** [`Talon Modification Module`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/talon-modification-module), [`Advanced Nanobiotics`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/advanced-nanobiotics), [`Aftermarket Firing Pin`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/aftermarket-firing-pin)  
**Optional Perks (Low Budget):** [`Compensator`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/compensator), [`Weapon Grease`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/weapon-grease), [`Armored Vest`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/armored-vest)  
**Situational Swap:** [`Ballistic Buffer`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/ballistic-buffer)

---

## 🛠️ Main Item Breakdown

### 1. [`Talon Modification Module`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/talon-modification-module)  
 **+15% Weapon Power**

A huge spike in Mercy’s overall output:

- **+15% Healing Beam power**
- **+15% Blaster damage** (for clutch self-defense)

This is your **core item** for becoming a healing/damage-boost monster in Round 2. It stacks with all other power boosts for insane value.

---

### 2. [`Advanced Nanobiotics`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/advanced-nanobiotics)  
 **+5% Weapon Power**, **+10% Attack Speed for 3s after healing an ally**

Dual-benefit item:

- Adds more **beam power**
- Grants you **10% attack speed burst** after each heal tick—letting you heal **even faster** in short bursts

Excellent for **duel support**, **sustain during dive**, and **Valk fights**.

---

### 3. [`Aftermarket Firing Pin`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/aftermarket-firing-pin)  
 **+10% Attack Speed**, **+5% Move Speed**

Buffs both your **healing frequency** and **movement speed**:

- Faster beam ticks = more healing
- Movement speed = better dodging, repositions, and mobility between allies

This makes Mercy feel **snappier, slipperier, and stronger**—a must-have for fast-paced fights.

---

## 💸 Optional Budget Picks (if low on points)

If you can't afford the full trio above, pick from these **lower-cost but effective alternatives**:

### [`Compensator`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/compensator)  
 **+5% Weapon Power**  
A great filler for boosting healing/blaster power at a low cost.

### [`Weapon Grease`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/weapon-grease)  
 **+5% Attack Speed**  
Solid for increasing your **healing tick rate**, even if just slightly. Always welcome.

### [`Armored Vest`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/armored-vest)  
 **+10 Armor**  
If you're still getting **focused or dived**, this is a cheap and reliable survivability boost. Especially useful if Valk or Res timing is crucial.

---

## ⚠️ Situational Swap: [`Ballistic Buffer`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/ballistic-buffer)

 **Pick if enemy has 2+ of:**  
 Reinhardt 🛡️, Orisa 🐎, Ashe 🔫, Freja ⚔️, Soldier: 76 👟, Ana 💉, Kiriko 🦊

Great vs **poke and projectile-heavy comps**.  
- Reduces ranged incoming damage  
- Keeps you alive vs. constant chip or burst  
- Especially good if you feel like you’re dying before you can make plays

---

## 🧠 Strategy Summary

- Stack **Weapon Power** (via Talon + Nanobiotics) for max healing and boost impact
- Use **Attack Speed** boosts (Nanobiotics + Firing Pin) for burst support windows
- **Move Speed** helps reposition and stay one step ahead of pressure
- Budget? Grab `Compensator` + `Grease`, or `Armored Vest` for survival
- Poked out of fights? Slot in `Ballistic Buffer` to stay in the game

---

 *"With speed in your wings and strength in your beam, you’re the storm behind every team push."*

# 🕊️ Mercy – **Round 3** Loadout Note  

**Primary Items (Epic/Rare):**  
- [`Martian Mender`](https://overwatch.fandom.com/wiki/Stadium/Items#Martian_Mender): *+25 HP, +10% Cooldown Reduction, Restore 3% of your life per second*
- [`Talon Modification Module`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/talon-modification-module): *+15% Weapon Power*  
- [`Icy Coolant`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/icy-coolant) *(assumed: +10% Weapon Power, +5% Cooldown Reduction)*  
- [`Ironclad Exhaust Ports`](https://overwatch.fandom.com/wiki/Stadium/Items#Ironclad_Exhaust_Ports): *5% Cooldown Reduction, when you use an ability gain 25 Overhealth over 3s*

**Optional Budget Items:**  
- [`Compensator`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/compensator): *+5% Weapon Power*  
- [`Weapon Grease`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/weapon-grease): *+5% Attack Speed* 
- [`Armored Vest`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/armored-vest): *25 Armor*

**Power (Continue reading to know which one to pick):**  
- [`Supply Surge`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/supply-surge): *Reloading your Staff grants tethered allies +20% Move Speed for 2s, restores 50% Ammo, and reduces their cooldowns by 3s (10s cooldown)*
- [`Tethered Tourniquet`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/tethered-tourniquet): *After swapping to blaster, Staff automatically heals allies at 100% effectiveness for every 1 s tethered, up to 10 s*
- [`Triage Unit`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/triage-unit): *Using Guardian Angel on allies below 50% health increases Staff healing by 25% for 3 s*
- [`Serenity`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/serenity): *Staff heals 10% more, and heals you even when healing full-health allies*

---

##  Strategy & Synergy Breakdown

###  Items — Why They Work Together

- **[`Martian Mender`](https://overwatch.fandom.com/wiki/Stadium/Items#Martian_Mender)** gives you **sustain and uptime**—extra HP, passive regen, and ability cooldown reduction keep you active longer.
- **[`Talon Modification Module`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/talon-modification-module)** massively boosts all aspects of Mercy’s output—healing, damage boost, and blaster DPS.  
- **[`Icy Coolant`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/icy-coolant)** layers in hybrid power and cooldown efficiency to fuel both offense and utility.  
- **[`Ironclad Exhaust Ports`](https://overwatch.fandom.com/wiki/Stadium/Items#Ironclad_Exhaust_Ports)** adds **timely shielding (Overhealth)** each time you use an ability—crucial during aggressive DPS bursts or retreats. 

###  Powers — When to Pick What

| Scenario | Power to Pick | Why |
|----------|---------------|-----|
| Enemy has multiple high-DPS threats (e.g., Zarya, Ashe, Genji, Mei, Soldier, Kiriko, Ana, Juno) | **[`Supply Surge`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/supply-surge)** | Grants team movement speed, ammo sustain, and cooldown resets—notably boosts survivability and DPS potential in chaotic fights. |
| You want to go all-in on DPS windows | **[`Tethered Tourniquet`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/tethered-tourniquet)** | Gives automatic healing ticks while in blaster mode; perfect for high-impact burst transitions. Hold if near ult to align healing with your ultimate.  |
| You need clutch saving power | **[`Triage Unit`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/triage-unit)** | Increases healing right after Guardian Angel to low-health allies, ideal in dive-heavy scenarios.  |
| You’re dying too often and need more self-recovery | **[`Serenity`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/serenity)** | Adds healing on top of healing—even full-health heals bleed to you; helps stay in fights longer.  |

###  Budget Fallbacks

If you’re short on gold mid-round:  
- **[`Compensator`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/compensator)** gives a small flat weapon power boost.  
- **[`Weapon Grease`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/weapon-grease)** adds attack speed—helpful for beam tick frequency.   
- **[`Armored Vest`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/armored-vest)** provides basic durability for pressure-heavy rounds.

---

##  Final Thoughts

In Round 3, Mercy becomes a dynamic **healing-engine with DPS clutch potential**. The ideal loadout stacks cooldown efficiency, self-sustain, offensive power, and strategic healing. Your well-timed Destiny (power) paired with these items will let you **heal, support, and out-DPS expectations**.

 *“Your beam is the tempo—when you flow, your team surges.”*

Let me know if you’d like to refine any build for a specific map or enemy comp!

# 🕊️ Mercy – **Round 4** Loadout Note  

---

## Primary Items — Choose One Depending on Your Needs

- [`Amari's Antidote`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/amari-s-antidote)  
  *+25 HP, +15% Weapon Power*  
  **Effect:** While healing allies below 50% HP, your weapon healing is increased by 15%.  
  **Why pick this?** Ideal if your team needs stronger burst healing in clutch low-health moments. Perfect for keeping key teammates alive through intense fights.

- [`Resurrection Rangefinder`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/resurrection-rangefinder)  
  *+10% Cooldown Reduction*  
  **Effect:** Increases Resurrection range by 75%.  
  **Why pick this?** Great for landing risky or unexpected rezzes safely from a distance, helping you bring teammates back from safer positions.

- [`Angeleisure Wear`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/angeleisure-wear)  
  *+25 HP*  
  **Effect:** While using Angelic Descent or Guardian Angel, heals 3% of your HP every second.  
  **Why pick this?** If you’re dying too often or need more survivability during mobility, this passive self-healing keeps you in the fight longer.

- [`Chain Evoker`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/chain-evoker)  
  *+50 Armor, +5% Weapon Power, +15% Ultimate Charge from damage boost*  
  **Effect:** Adds durability and increases your ultimate charge speed when damage boosting allies.  
  **Why pick this?** For aggressive playstyles that heavily rely on damage boosting and faster ultimate uptime, this item amplifies both survivability and impact.

---

## Budget Optional Items (If You Lack Gold)

- [`Compensator`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/compensator) — +5% Weapon Power, a modest boost for healing/damage output.  
- [`Weapon Grease`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/weapon-grease) — +5% Attack Speed, improves healing beam tick rate.  
- [`Armored Vest`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/armored-vest) — +25 Armor, basic durability buffer.  

---

**Summary:**  
Pick **one** of the primary situational items depending on whether you want **more healing burst** (`Amari's Antidote`), **better risky rezzes** (`Resurrection Rangefinder`), **extra survivability** (`Angeleisure Wear`), or **damage amp and ultimate charge** (`Chain Evoker`). Use the budget items as fallback options if you don’t have enough gold.

---

# 🕊️ Mercy – **Round 5** Loadout Note  
**Theme:** *Adaptive Healing & Survivability Based on Previous Picks and Enemy Composition*  

---

## Power Options — Pick Based on Round 3 Choices & Enemy Threats

- **[`Battle Medic`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/battle-medic)**  
  *Recommended if you picked [`Tethered Tourniquet`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/tethered-tourniquet) in Round 3.*  
  **Why pick this?** Enhances the damage you do during the 10 seconds the round 3 power gives you.

- **[`Supply Surge`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/supply-surge)**  
  *Pick if you didn’t take it Round 3 and your team has two or more of the heroes:* Monkey, Zarya, Junkerqueen, Ashe, Genji, Mei, Soldier, Kiriko, Ana, Juno.  
  **Why pick this?** Provides move speed, ammo sustain, and cooldown resets to boost your team’s effectiveness in fights.

- **[`Serenity`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/serenity)**  
  *Choose if you need extra survivability and are dying too often.*  
  **Why pick this?** Grants passive self-healing even when healing full-health allies, improving your longevity.

- **[`Whambulance`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/powers/whambulance)**  
  *Pick if none of the above apply.*  
  **Why pick this?** Focuses on defensive mobility and survivability, giving you more options to reposition and escape danger.  
  - If you pick **Whambulance**, also take [`Angelic Acrobatics`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/angelic-acrobatics) for better aerial mobility and survivability.

---

## Item Options — Situational & Budget Picks

- **Primary Situational Items (Pick One):**  
  - [`Amari's Antidote`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/amari-s-antidote)  
    *If you didn’t pick this in Round 4, pick it here for burst healing.*  
  - [`Booster Jets`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/booster-jets)  
    *Pick this if you took Amari’s Antidote earlier for even more healing*  
  - [`Resurrection Rangefinder`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/resurrection-rangefinder)  
    *For safer, longer-range resurrects.*  
  - [`Angeleisure Wear`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/angeleisure-wear)  
    *For passive healing during mobility and more survivability.*  
  - [`Chain Evoker`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/chain-evoker)  
    *For more armor and faster ultimate charge when damage boosting.*

- **Budget Optional Items:**  
  - [`Compensator`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/compensator) — +5% Weapon Power  
  - [`Weapon Grease`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/weapon-grease) — +5% Attack Speed  
  - [`Armored Vest`](https://stadiumbuilds.io/items/armored-vest) — +25 Armor  

---

## Summary & Playstyle Tips

- Use **Battle Medic** if you want to lean into aggressive healing while DPSing with your blaster (synergizes with `Tethered Tourniquet` from Round 3).  
- If your team has a heavy frontline or poke presence (heroes like Monkey, Zarya, Ashe, Soldier, etc.), **Supply Surge** will keep your team fast and fueled.  
- Need to survive more? **Serenity** and mobility-based **Whambulance + Angelic Acrobatics** let you dodge and self-heal effectively.  
- Pick your situational items to enhance healing, survivability, or utility based on what you didn’t take earlier and your team’s needs.  

---

 *“Flexibility is your greatest strength—adapt your build to the flow of battle and lead your team to victory.”*

- Prioritize **Resurrection Rangefinder** for safer, extended-range rezzes in late rounds when clutch revives can turn fights.  
- **Hardlight Accelerator** increases both your healing power and healing speed, vital for sustained team support.
